targets.query:
from(bucket: "facies-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "welllog")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Well Name"] == "${well}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "GR" or r._field == "ILD_log10" or r._field == "DeltaPHI" or r._field == "PHIND" or r._field == "PE" or r._field == "RELPOS")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "Formation", "Well Name"])

from(bucket: "facies-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "welllog")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Well Name"] == "${well}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Depth")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "Formation", "Well Name"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "facies-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "welllog")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Well Name"] == "${well}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Facies")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "Formation", "Well Name"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "facies-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "welllog")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Well Name"] == "${well}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "GR")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "Formation", "Well Name"])
  |> last()
